metadata.description: Org SDLC skills: role plugins for writing intents, specs and plans, the org policy skills they apply, guardrail hooks, and example agents.

plugins.name: org-policies
plugins.description: Brand, security and UX policy skills applied by every SDLC stage.

plugins.name: org-guardrails
plugins.description: Hooks that enforce the org ADRs on every machine: no merge, force-push or .env reads, spec gate, stop gate.

plugins.name: sdlc-intent
plugins.description: Product owners: write intent.md, review spec.md against it, resolve flagged concerns, accept the spec.

plugins.name: sdlc-spec
plugins.description: Spec writers: turn an accepted intent.md into spec.md with flagged concerns.

plugins.name: sdlc-plan
plugins.description: Engineers: turn an accepted spec.md into plan.md for plan mode.

plugins.name: example-agents
plugins.description: Example subagents to copy and adapt: policy-reviewer, adr-scout, requirements-tracer, green-keeper.
